title: music-dsl conformance case
description: A single language-agnostic conformance case for the music_dsl theory library. Op-dispatched: the runner calls OPS[op](**args) and asserts `expect`. Mirrors conformance/dsl-core/schema. Function ops assert expect.value; model ops (added in later builds) assert expect.model or expect.error.

op.description: Op name; the cross-port contract. Each runner implements the same set.

args.description: Keyword args passed to the op.

expect.description: Exactly one of value (function ops), model (model ops, later builds), or error (failure sentinel).
